category_law: Every figure below was produced by executing pyreadstat 1.3.6 against synthetic carriers created inside a temporary directory. No real survey source was opened, located, named or characterised. Nothing here qualifies any real source.

carriers.generation: Written by pyreadstat's own writer from a 4-row, 2-variable in-memory frame, then discarded with the temporary directory.

explicit_measurement_basis.basis: Exact, complete counts at the application-owned file object that the compiled reader reads through.
explicit_measurement_basis.why_complete: On the broker route the parser is handed an EMPTY path and ReadStat's open handler is a no-op returning 0. The compiled reader has no path to open and cannot obtain any byte except by calling the broker's read(). There is no side channel.
explicit_measurement_basis.unit_of_account: one read() crossing into the compiled reader

P1_path_based_baseline.purpose: Establish the uninstrumented path-string baseline against which brokered results are compared.

P2_brokered_metadata_SAV.purpose: Literal O1-C07 path-level open account, metadata route.
P2_brokered_metadata_SAV.significance_of_first_read: The reader's very first read consumed exactly 176 bytes, matching the Part C header-prefix size HQ192 identified from the Python layer. Corroborated from the compiled reader's own read pattern.

P3_brokered_full_decode_DTA.purpose: Literal O1-C07 path-level open account, full decode route.

P4_equivalence_at_test_grain.purpose: Ordinary synthetic decode results remain equivalent to the uninstrumented runtime.

P5_excess_read_refused.purpose: Impose a maximum and refuse the excess operation before it occurs.

P6_excess_bytes_refused.purpose: Second ceiling type, on bytes rather than read count.
P6_excess_bytes_refused.note: The ceiling is checked before each read, so the total can exceed the maximum by at most the size of the in-flight read. This is a stated granularity, not a defect.

P7_chunked_helper_SAV.purpose: Exercise the read_file_in_chunks / batch path where feasible.

P7b_chunked_helper_DTA.purpose: Same helper on DTA, the format SRC27 uses.
P7b_chunked_helper_DTA.message: This version of the file format is not supported
P7b_chunked_helper_DTA.honest_note: Recorded as a failure, not worked around silently. Path-based chunked DTA succeeds, so this is an interaction between brokering and chunked DTA specifically.

P8_layer_separation.purpose: Distinguish the four account classes the commission requires be kept separate.

open_count.note: the only path-level open in the system

P9_chunked_dta_root_cause.purpose: Isolate the cause of P7b and establish whether the path is governable at all.

reused_broker_across_chunks.error: ReadstatError: This version of the file format is not supported

P9_chunked_dta_root_cause.root_cause: ReadStat's DTA row_offset parse expects the underlying file at position 0. A broker reused across successive chunk parses has an advanced position, so the parse fails.
P9_chunked_dta_root_cause.remedy: The application owns the chunk loop and opens a fresh broker per chunk. That makes the chunked DTA path governable.
P9_chunked_dta_root_cause.consequence_for_SRC27: SRC27's full-route decode IS governable via the broker. The chunked batch path (the reader site earlier lanes flagged) is governable ONLY via an application-driven loop with a fresh broker per chunk.

requirement_coverage.instrument_actual_compiled_reader_path_o: MET. The owner is the application-owned file object, and it observes 1 open with the compiled reader contributing 0.
requirement_coverage.observe_counts_with_explicit_measurement: MET. Basis stated above; see P8.
requirement_coverage.impose_a_maximum_and_refuse_before_it_oc: MET. P5 and P6, both with executed=false on the denied operation.
requirement_coverage.exercise_metadata_normal_and_chunked_whe: MET. Metadata P2, normal P3, chunked P7/P7b/P9.
requirement_coverage.do_not_claim_survey_semantic_equivalence: OBSERVED. No such claim is made anywhere in this packet.
